name: Nagumo Chiaki
source:
A second-year student in the violin department at Shukusei Music Academy. A girl with Peter Pan syndrome who loves stuffed toys and sweets. Perhaps due to her overprotective upbringing, she is a very demanding and a very spoiled young lady. She
is still afraid to go to the bathroom alone at night. A timid girl who cries easily for any reason.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/19980701104740/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/special/syusaku/syusaku12.htm]the game's website, archived[/url]]
